---
title: "Data Exploration"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Read the local data
df <- read_csv("data/nc_census_pums.csv")
head(df)
```

## 1. Contingency Tables

```{r}
# One-Way Contingency Table: Distribution of Educational Attainment
edu_table <- table(df$education)
edu_table

# Two-Way Contingency Table: Education by Sex
edu_sex_table <- table(df$education, df$sex)
edu_sex_table

# Row Proportions across Education Levels
round(prop.table(edu_sex_table, margin = 1), 3)


```

## 2. Grouped Numerical Summaries

```{r}
# summaries of gas cost and rent grouped by education and sex
# Accounting for survey person weights (weight = PWGTP)
summary_stats <- df %>%
  group_by(education, sex) %>%
  summarize(
    weighted_mean_gas  = sum(gas_cost * weight, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(weight, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_gas         = median(gas_cost, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_gas             = sd(gas_cost, na.rm = TRUE),
    weighted_mean_rent = sum(rent_burden * weight, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(weight, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_rent        = median(rent_burden, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_rent            = sd(rent_burden, na.rm = TRUE),
    iqr_rent           = IQR(rent_burden, na.rm = TRUE),
    sample_size        = n(),
    .groups            = "drop"
  )

summary_stats
```

## 3. Graphical Summaries

```{r}
# Plot 1: Bar Chart
# Distribution of education
ggplot(df, aes(x = education)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "#1b4f72") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Educational Attainment in North Carolina",
    x = "Education Level",
    y = "Sample Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
# Plot 2: Side-by-Side Bar Chart
# Educational attainment grouped by sex
ggplot(df, aes(x = education, fill = sex)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Male" = "#2980b9", "Female" = "#8e44ad")) +
  labs(
    title = "Educational Attainment by Sex in North Carolina",
    x = "Education Level",
    y = "Count",
    fill = "Sex"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
# Plot 3: Boxplot with Faceting
# Gross rent burden across education levels, faceted by sex
ggplot(df %>% filter(rent_burden > 0), aes(x = education, y = rent_burden, fill = education)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.15) +
  facet_wrap(~ sex) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 100)) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Blues") +
  labs(
    title = "Gross Rent Burden (% of Income) by Education Faceted by Sex",
    x = "Education Level",
    y = "Rent as % of Income (GRPIP)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
# Plot 4: Scatter Plot with Smoothing
# Gas cost vs. Age, colored by sex with lines
ggplot(df %>% filter(gas_cost > 0), aes(x = age, y = gas_cost, color = sex)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Male" = "#2980b9", "Female" = "#8e44ad")) +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly Gas Cost vs. Age Trajectory by Sex",
    x = "Age (Years)",
    y = "Monthly Gas Cost ($)",
    color = "Sex"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Plot 5: Grouped Density Plot
# Distribution of gas costs grouped and by education level
ggplot(df %>% filter(gas_cost > 0, gas_cost <= 500), aes(x = gas_cost, fill = education)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.35) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark") +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly Gas Cost Density across Education Levels",
    x = "Monthly Gas Cost ($)",
    y = "Density",
    fill = "Education Level"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Plot 6: Uncovered Plot Type 2D Heatmap
# Binned 2D density of Age vs. Rent Burden (GRPIP)
ggplot(df %>% filter(rent_burden > 0, rent_burden <= 100), aes(x = age, y = rent_burden)) +
  geom_bin_2d(bins = 30) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma") +
  labs(
    title = "2D Density Heatmap: Age vs. Gross Rent Burden",
    x = "Age (Years)",
    y = "Rent as % of Income (GRPIP)",
    fill = "Observations"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
